issue.title: [NSFW] txxx.me: clicking the player opens a popunder

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

Other ad blocker

### AdGuard version

wBlock 3.2.1 (Safari content blocker that uses AdGuard filters and SafariConverterLib)

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Annoyances — pop-ups, cookie warnings, etc.

### Which browser(s) do you use?

Safari

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

[NSFW] https://txxx.me/videos/21126753/innocent-lesbians2/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, AdGuard URL Tracking filter

### Annoyances

AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter

### Add your comment and screenshots

1. Open any video page on txxx.me (the same happens on the home page after clicking a thumbnail), click "Enter" on the age notice, then click the player's play button. The click opens a popunder tab in the background. In two tries it went to `https://viiukuhe.com/dc/?blockID=420763&subID=0&page=https%3A%2F%2Ftxxx.me%2F&keywords=straight` and `https://www.javideos.com/?t=1000`.

   The existing `txxx.*` rules do reach the page. For this URL the engine returns the `abort-on-property-read ExoLoader` and `remove-node-text script, AdManager` scriptlets, but the popunder still opens. `viiukuhe.com` isn't in any of the enabled lists. Safari 27.2 on macOS 27.2, reproduced on 2026-10-13.

   Originally reported to wBlock in https://github.com/0xCUB3/wBlock/issues/977.

2. Screenshots: none attached because of the site's content. The popunder URLs are listed above.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://www.miruro.tv/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.miruro.tv%2F) ### Comment > 1. Open Firefox Mobile app > 2. Visit https://www.miruro.tv/ > 3. Click any on screen button > 4. New tab automatically opens and redirects user to third party advertisement or fake iPhone vulnerability report screen. > 5. Close undesired tab > 6. Go back to original website > 7. You can now click any button one time > 8. Clicking a second button resets the process and triggers a new tab opening. ### Screenshots

They are not covered by AdGuard Base, AdGuard Spanish/Portuguese, EasyList or uBO filters (none of them has any rule for ggmax.com.br). > > **Where they appear** (checked all 191 category pages on 2026-10-10): > - First 2-3 slots of 17 category pages, 48 ads total. Examples: https://ggmax.com.br/jogos/brawl-stars , /jogos/free-fire , /jogos/roblox , /jogos/valorant , /jogos/league-of-legends , /outros/discord > - Search results, e.g. https://ggmax.com.br/busca/steam%20key > - Not seen on the homepage or the "Anúncios parecidos" block on listing pages. > > **How to identify them:** > - Sponsored cards contain `span.promotion-label` (text "Ad", title "Anúncio patrocinado") and links with `rel="sponsored"`. > - Card wrapper: `.category__announcements__announcement` on category pages, `.search__announcements__announcement` on search pages. > - Click tracking: `POST https://ggmax.com.br/api/gg-ads/click` (body `{ad_token}`). > - Tracking cookie `gg-ads-session` (180 days), sent to the API as header `x-gg-session`. > > **Suggested rules** (cosmetic rule tested: hides exactly the sponsored cards on category and search pages, no regular listings affected): > ``` > ggmax.com.br##div:has(> .announcement-box > .promotion-label) > ||ggmax.com.br/api/gg-ads/ > ``` > > Screenshot: sponsored cards outlined in red (the "Ad" label in the bottom-right corner of each card). ### Screenshots

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: akirabox.to - pop-up on download button in Firefox (abort-on-stack-trace '<anonymous>' doesn't match)
issue.body:
### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.5 ### What type of problem have you encountered? Missed ads or ad leftovers ### Which browser(s) do you use? Firefox ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://akirabox.to/BnkmW6v61GR0/file ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances _No response_ ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots 1. The rule `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', '')` (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt) doesn't match on Firefox. **Firefox 158.0 + AdGuard Browser Extension 5.5.3.5** (default settings, no other blocker): the rule is applied (it shows up in the filtering log), but clicking the download button opens a popup that redirects to a fake download / malicious site. The popup stays open. **Chrome + AdGuard Browser Extension:** same rule, the download starts on the first click, no popup. **Firefox 158.0 + uBlock Origin 1.75.0** (uses the same rule via the AdGuard Base list): the popup opens (`about:blank`, then a redirect to `link-file-*.diimsm1o.website`) and a uBO `$popup` filter closes it, but each click is consumed, so the download only starts on the third click. **Likely cause:** In Chrome, stack frames for Function/eval code contain `` (e.g. `eval at (...)`), while Firefox writes them as `anonymous@https://... line N > Function`, so the `` needle never matches on Firefox. **Tested fix:** Replacing the needle `` with `anonymous` (which matches both formats) fixes it on Firefox, with the download starting on the first click and no popup: - Firefox + AdGuard, as a user rule: `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', 'anonymous')` - Firefox + uBO, in My filters: `akirabox.to##+js(abort-on-stack-trace, atob, anonymous)` **Suggested change:** `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', 'anonymous')` 2. Screenshot
Screenshot: popup opened on Firefox + AdGuard

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.5 ### What type of problem have you encountered? Missed ads or ad leftovers ### Which browser(s) do you use? Firefox ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://akirabox.to/BnkmW6v61GR0/file ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances _No response_ ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots 1. The rule `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', '')` (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt) doesn't match on Firefox. **Firefox 158.0 + AdGuard Browser Extension 5.5.3.5** (default settings, no other blocker): the rule is applied (it shows up in the filtering log), but clicking the download button opens a popup that redirects to a fake download / malicious site. The popup stays open. **Chrome + AdGuard Browser Extension:** same rule, the download starts on the first click, no popup. **Firefox 158.0 + uBlock Origin 1.75.0** (uses the same rule via the AdGuard Base list): the popup opens (`about:blank`, then a redirect to `link-file-*.diimsm1o.website`) and a uBO `$popup` filter closes it, but each click is consumed, so the download only starts on the third click. **Likely cause:** In Chrome, stack frames for Function/eval code contain `` (e.g. `eval at (...)`), while Firefox writes them as `anonymous@https://... line N > Function`, so the `` needle never matches on Firefox. **Tested fix:** Replacing the needle `` with `anonymous` (which matches both formats) fixes it on Firefox, with the download starting on the first click and no popup: - Firefox + AdGuard, as a user rule: `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', 'anonymous')` - Firefox + uBO, in My filters: `akirabox.to##+js(abort-on-stack-trace, atob, anonymous)` **Suggested change:** `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', 'anonymous')` 2. Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.5 ### What type of problem have you encountered? Missed ads or ad leftovers ### Which browser(s) do you use? Firefox ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://akirabox.to/BnkmW6v61GR0/file ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances _No response_ ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots 1. The rule `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', '')` (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt) doesn't match on Firefox. **Firefox 158.0 + AdGuard Browser Extension 5.5.3.5** (default settings, no other blocker): the rule is applied (it shows up in the filtering log), but clicking the download button opens a popup that redirects to a fake download / malicious site. The popup stays open. **Chrome + AdGuard Browser Extension:** same rule, the download starts on the first click, no popup. **Firefox 158.0 + uBlock Origin 1.75.0** (uses the same rule via the AdGuard Base list): the popup opens (`about:blank`, then a redirect to `link-file-*.diimsm1o.website`) and a uBO `$popup` filter closes it, but each click is consumed, so the download only starts on the third click. **Likely cause:** In Chrome, stack frames for Function/eval code contain `` (e.g. `eval at (...)`), while Firefox writes them as `anonymous@https://... line N > Function`, so the `` needle never matches on Firefox. **Tested fix:** Replacing the needle `` with `anonymous` (which matches both formats) fixes it on Firefox, with the download starting on the first click and no popup: - Firefox + AdGuard, as a user rule: `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', 'anonymous')` - Firefox + uBO, in My filters: `akirabox.to##+js(abort-on-stack-trace, atob, anonymous)` **Suggested change:** `akirabox.com,akirabox.to#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-stack-trace', 'atob', 'anonymous')` 2. issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
### Current retest status — 14 October 2026 (JST)

**The AdGuard Japanese filter was ENABLED and verified during the retests (version 2.0.77.44).** All five custom document exceptions were disabled for the initial comparisons; the later original-Japanese tests had Google Translate disabled.

- Kanji/idiom first-question access and Resort wall/menu access worked without their exceptions; those three exceptions were removed.
- **Paw remains unresolved:** with protection ON, the normal bonus-ad page stayed loading through approximately 65 seconds; with protection OFF, normal ad completion and bonus entry worked. The retained Paw exception is still unverified because a fresh eligible ad is required.
- The separate English vocabulary game is tracked in [#222607](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/222607#issuecomment-6148987274). Its gate disappeared with only the built-in AdGuard DNS filter disabled and returned when that filter was restored. The exact hostname/rule is unknown.

The original “Japanese disabled” and Chrome 140 entries below describe the historical initial report; the dated retests and installed Chrome 155.0.8059.39 correction supersede them. The Japanese-filter question was already answered in [the earlier follow-up](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/244149#issuecomment-6150655951) and is answered again in [this direct reply](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/244149#issuecomment-6157738716).

---

### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================


---

### Consolidated retest — 14 October 2026 (JST)

Following the maintainer's consolidation request, this update covers #244150 and #244151 alongside the original quizzes.

**Configuration:** AdGuard Japanese filter enabled, version **2.0.77.44**, displayed update **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**. All five temporary document exceptions were disabled and checked before testing. The later tests used original Japanese, Google Translate disabled and Japanese first in Chrome's languages. Chrome remained muted with its per-app audio-focus operation set to ignore; these audio settings were unchanged between the Paw comparisons.

**Quizzes:** both `ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/` and `ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/` reached the actual first question without their exceptions. The original access gates were absent. Fresh original-Japanese retests after disabling translation also reached **第1問** on both routes with protection enabled. Full quiz completion, advertisements and reward credit were not tested.

**Resort (#244151):** normal entry with protection enabled and its exception disabled reached the original-Japanese wall and contents menu; a promotional overlay could be dismissed. This verifies wall/menu access, not every individual game or advertisement.

**Paw (#244150), protection enabled:** after 18 remaining ordinary rounds without reload, index counter 0 → Next → `already.php` → **動画を見る** → `movie.php` remained **loading** at entry, about 30 seconds and about 65 seconds, without a playback/completion control.

**Paw protection-off baseline:** the disabled state was verified, then fresh normal entry through the same route showed **広告を見る！**. It opened an actual advertiser card with a video panel. At about 30 seconds, **報酬を獲得しました** and the close × appeared. Closing returned **おやつをゲットする！**, which opened `oyatsu_index.php` / **おやつモード**. The normal advertisement-completion and bonus-entry flow therefore worked with protection disabled under the otherwise unchanged stated settings. The responsible filter/module remains unisolated. Protection was restored and verified enabled afterward.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973
